model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: 2027 Subaru Uncharted Specifications and Equipment, 'Overall Length'. Saved as sources/subaru-2027-uncharted-specifications.pdf.

width_in.note: 'Overall Width'; the sheet doesn't say whether mirrors are included. C/D lists the same figure as width without mirrors.

awd.label: Sport, GT
awd.note: 2027 spec sheet: 'Available Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive'; output listed as Premium FWD vs Sport and GT (dual motor). Pricing release: Sport has 'dual electric motors ... paired with Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive'.

charge_port.note: 'NACS charge port on right fender'. Pricing release: 'uses a high-speed North American Charging Standard (NACS) port'.

supercharger_access.note: 'NACS charge port on right fender'. Pricing release: 'uses a high-speed North American Charging Standard (NACS) port'.

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Subaru among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'For new vehicles that are NACS-equipped, no adapter will be necessary.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: 2027 pricing release: 'After successful debut in early 2026, 2027 Subaru Uncharted returns'; 'The 2027 Subaru Uncharted will arrive in retailers this fall.' Release date not shown on the saved page.

epa_range.note: EPA's 2026 listings (50302, 50303) carry the same figures. Trim mapping from Subaru's spec sheet (Premium FWD 308, Sport 287, GT 273).

trims.note: 2027 spec sheet header 'Premium, Sport, GT'; 'Premium FWD' throughout; X-MODE 'Standard on Sport and GT'.

entries.note: 'Lithium-ion: 104 cells, 74.7 kWh'. Subaru doesn't say usable or gross. C/D's review lists 67 kWh, labelled as C/D's own estimate; not used.
2027 pricing release: 'DC-fast charging speeds up to 150 kW'.
'DC fast charging: 10% to 80% charge as quickly as 28 minutes'. Charger power not stated with the time; the release credits 'battery preconditioning and up to 150 kW charging speeds'.
Not mentioned in the 2027 spec sheet, the 2027 pricing release or C/D pages.

cargo_cu_ft.note: 'EPA Cargo Volume 23.0 cu. ft. (rear seatbacks up) / 59.5 cu. ft. (rear seatbacks down)'. Text extraction staggers this table; reading confirmed by C/D.

height_in.note: 'Overall Height 63.8 in.' (one figure for all trims).

battery.text: 8-year / 100,000-mile High Voltage Battery Warranty; 8-year / 100,000-mile Battery and Electric Drive Unit Limited Warranty

highway_tests.note: C/D 75-mph highway range test. Temperature not stated.

notes.text: Battery size is Subaru's figure; Subaru doesn't say whether it is usable or gross.
The 10-80% time is Subaru's 'as quickly as' figure with no charger power stated.
